AcceptDataworksEvent.description_en: PAI accepts and processes system event messages from DataWorks
AcceptDataworksEvent.description_zh: PAI系统用于接收并处理DataWorks发送的系统事件消息

AddImage.description_en: Adds a custom image to a workspace
AddImage.description_zh: 添加自定义镜像到工作空间

AddImageLabels.description_en: Adds labels to a specified image

AddMemberRole.description_en: Assigns a role to a member in a workspace, granting that member the role's permissions
AddMemberRole.description_zh: 为工作空间内的成员添加某个角色，使其拥有角色的权限

ChangeResourceGroup.description_en: Changes the resource group of a specified resource
ChangeResourceGroup.description_zh: 更改资源ID对应的资源组

CreateCodeSource.description_en: Creates a code configuration in PAI. You can configure a Git code branch and CommitId. After the configuration is created, it can be referenced in DLC jobs
CreateCodeSource.description_zh: 创建代码配置到PAI，支持配置Git的代码分支与CommitId。创建完成后，可以在DLC作业中引用

CreateConnection.description_en: Creates a connection to link PAI cloud services with your models, databases, and other services. This is useful for scenarios such as LangStudio and multimodal dataset retrieval
CreateConnection.description_zh: 创建连接。用于LangStudio、数据集多模态检索服务等场景中连接PAI云端到客户的模型、数据库等服务

CreateDatasetFileMetas.description_en: Creates file metadata records in a dataset in batches
CreateDatasetFileMetas.description_zh: 批量创建数据集下的文件元数据记录

CreateDatasetVersionLabels.description_en: Creates labels for a dataset version
CreateDatasetVersionLabels.description_zh: 创建数据集版本的标签

CreateImageBuild.description_en: Builds a custom image based on the specified configuration. After the image is successfully built, it is added to the list of custom images in the current workspace
CreateImageBuild.description_zh: 根据指定配置构建自定义镜像， 构建成功后，会添加到当前工作空间的自定义镜像里

CreateMember.description_en: Adds one or more users to a workspace
CreateMember.description_zh: 添加用户到工作空间，作为工作空间的成员，可以添加多个用户为成员

CreateModel.description_en: Creates a model, which is a collection of model versions. You must specify information such as the model name and description
CreateModel.description_zh: 创建模型。模型是模型版本的集合，创建模型时需要指定模型名称，描述等信息

CreateModelVersion.description_en: Adds a new version to a specified model

CreateModelVersionLabels.description_en: Creates labels for a model version

CreateProductOrders.description_en: Purchases products. This operation supports pay-as-you-go purchases of DataWorks, OSS, PAI, and MaxCompute
CreateProductOrders.description_zh: 购买产品，目前只支持购买DataWorks后付费、OSS后付费、PAI后付费、MaxCompute后付费

CreateRun.description_en: Creates a run. A run belongs to an experiment and can be associated with a specific workload or can be a standalone code execution
CreateRun.description_zh: 创建一次运行，运行（Run）属于一个实验（Experiment），可以与具体的workload关联，也可以是一次单纯的代码运行

CreateWorkspaceResource.description_en: Add a resource reference to a workspace
CreateWorkspaceResource.description_zh: 添加资源引用到工作空间

DeleteCodeSource.description_en: Deletes a code source configuration by its ID
DeleteCodeSource.description_zh: 指定ID，删除一个代码配置

DeleteDatasetFileMetas.description_en: Deletes file metadata records from a dataset in batches
DeleteDatasetFileMetas.description_zh: 批量删除数据集下的文件元数据记录

DeleteDatasetVersion.description_en: Deletes a specified version of a dataset. This operation cannot be used to delete version v1. Version v1 is deleted with the dataset when you call the DeleteDataset operation
DeleteDatasetVersion.description_zh: 删除指定版本的数据集信息。其中版本v1无法使用本接口删除，需要使用DeleteDataset接口删除数据集的时候同步删除

DeleteDatasetVersionLabels.description_en: Deletes labels from a dataset version
DeleteDatasetVersionLabels.description_zh: 删除数据集版本的标签

DeleteExperimentLabel.description_en: Deletes a label from an experiment

DeleteModelVersionLabels.description_en: Deletes labels from a model version

DeleteRunLabel.description_en: Deletes a label from a run

DeleteWorkspace.description_en: Deletes a workspace. This operation does not release associated resources. You must release them manually
DeleteWorkspace.description_zh: 删除工作空间，关联的资源不会释放，需要您自已释放

DeleteWorkspaceResource.description_en: Detaches a resource from a workspace. This operation does not delete the underlying resource
DeleteWorkspaceResource.description_zh: 删除工作空间对资源的引用，不会删除底层的资源

DeleteWorkspaceRoles.description_en: Deletes one or more roles from a workspace
DeleteWorkspaceRoles.description_zh: 批量删除工作空间角色

GetCodeSource.description_en: Retrieves the details of a code source configuration
GetCodeSource.description_zh: 获取一个代码配置的详细信息

GetConnection.description_en: Retrieves the details of a connection

GetDatasetFileMeta.description_en: Retrieves the metadata record of a specified file in a dataset
GetDatasetFileMeta.description_zh: 获取数据集下的指定文件元数据记录

GetDatasetFileMetasStatistics.description_en: Retrieves statistics for metadata in a dataset
GetDatasetFileMetasStatistics.description_zh: 获取数据集下元数据的统计信息

GetDatasetJobConfig.description_en: Retrieves the configuration of a dataset job

GetDatasetVersion.description_en: Retrieves the information of a specified dataset version
GetDatasetVersion.description_zh: 获取指定版本的数据集信息

GetDefaultWorkspace.description_en: Retrieves the details of the default workspace
GetDefaultWorkspace.description_zh: 获取默认工作空间详情

GetImage.description_en: Retrieves the details of an image

GetInstanceJob.description_en: Gets the details of a job

GetMember.description_en: Retrieves a member of a workspace

GetModel.description_en: Gets the details of a specified model
GetModel.description_zh: 获取指定模型详情信息

GetPermission.description_en: Retrieves the permissions of a workspace

GetWorkspace.description_en: Retrieves the details of a workspace
GetWorkspace.description_zh: 获取工作空间详细信息

GetWorkspaceRole.description_en: Gets information about a specific role within a workspace

ListCodeSources.description_en: Queries a list of code configurations. This operation supports pagination, sorting, and conditional filtering
ListCodeSources.description_zh: 查询代码配置列表，支持分页、排序和按条件过滤

ListConfigs.description_en: Retrieves the list of workspace configurations
ListConfigs.description_zh: 获取工作空间配置列表

ListDatasetFileMetas.description_en: Queries the list of dataset files

ListDatasetJobConfigs.description_en: Lists dataset job configurations in batches
ListDatasetJobConfigs.description_zh: 批量查询数据集任务配置

ListDatasetJobs.description_en: Retrieves a list of dataset tasks

ListDatasetVersions.description_en: Retrieves a list of dataset versions

ListDatasets.description_en: Retrieves the list of datasets in a specified workspace
ListDatasets.description_zh: 获取某个工作空间下的数据集列表

ListImageLabels.description_en: Queries a list of image labels

ListMembers.description_zh: 获取工作空间的成员列表

ListModelVersions.description_en: Retrieves a list of model versions

ListPermissions.description_en: Retrieves a list of user permissions in a workspace
ListPermissions.description_zh: 获取用户在工作空间内的权限列表

ListQuotas.description_en: Retrieves a list of resource quotas

ListResources.description_en: Lists resources associated with a workspace
ListResources.description_zh: 获取工作空间内已关联的资源列表

ListRunMetrics.description_en: Retrieves a list of metric records for a run

ListWorkspaceRoles.description_en: Lists the roles in a specified workspace

ListWorkspaceUsers.description_en: Lists users who have not joined a workspace and can be added as workspace members
ListWorkspaceUsers.description_zh: 列出未加入工作空间的用户列表，这些用户可被加入工作空间成为成员

ListWorkspaces.description_en: Retrieves the list of workspaces in a specified region
ListWorkspaces.description_zh: 获取某个地域下的工作空间列表

LogRunMetrics.description_en: Records the metrics of a run in a batch

PublishCodeSource.description_en: Publishes a private code source, making it public in a workspace
PublishCodeSource.description_zh: 发布私有的代码配置到工作空间公开可见

PublishDataset.description_en: Publishes a private dataset in a workspace
PublishDataset.description_zh: 将私有数据集在工作空间内公开

PublishImage.description_en: Publishes an image and changes its visibility from PRIVATE to PUBLIC
PublishImage.description_zh: 发布镜像，把镜像的可见性从PRIVATE变为PUBLIC

RemoveImageLabels.description_en: Removes a label from an image

RemoveMemberRole.description_en: Removes a role from a member

SetExperimentLabels.description_en: Updates the labels of an experiment

UpdateConfig.description_zh: 更新或新增工作空间配置

UpdateConfigs.description_en: Updates or creates workspace configurations in batches
UpdateConfigs.description_zh: 批量更新或新增工作空间配置

UpdateDataset.description_en: Updates the properties of a dataset, such as its name and description
UpdateDataset.description_zh: 更新数据集，支持更新名称，描述等

UpdateDatasetFileMetas.description_en: Updates multiple file metadata records in a dataset
UpdateDatasetFileMetas.description_zh: 批量更新数据集下的文件元数据记录

UpdateDatasetVersion.description_en: Updates the information of a specified dataset version
UpdateDatasetVersion.description_zh: 更新指定版本的数据集信息

UpdateDefaultWorkspace.description_en: Sets a workspace as the default
UpdateDefaultWorkspace.description_zh: 将某个工作空间指定为默认工作空间

UpdateModel.description_en: Updates the basic configuration of a model
UpdateModel.description_zh: 更新模型的基本配置信息

UpdatePrompt.description_en: Updates the prompt of a dataset

UpdateRun.description_en: Updates the details of a run

UpdateWorkspace.description_en: Updates the name and description of a workspace
UpdateWorkspace.description_zh: 更新工作空间名称和描述信息

UpdateWorkspaceRole.description_en: Updates a role in a workspace
